avoid_supplements.name: Metoclopramide
avoid_supplements.mechanism: D2-receptor antagonist directly opposes pramipexole's dopaminergic effects, reducing efficacy in Parkinson's disease
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; select alternative antiemetics (ondansetron, domperidone)

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin B6
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Vitamin B6 antagonizes dopamine effects and may reduce pramipexole efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Limit supplemental B6 to <25 mg daily; monitor symptom control

caution_supplements.name: Iron supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce pramipexole absorption if taken simultaneously
caution_supplements.action: Separate dosing by 2+ hours; monitor for reduced efficacy

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive hypotensive effects; may increase dizziness/syncope risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure; counsel on fall prevention

avoid_foods.name: High-protein meals (concurrent dosing)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Amino acids compete with pramipexole absorption via intestinal transporters
avoid_foods.action: Take pramipexole consistently with or without food; avoid timing with heavy protein intake

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and orthostatic hypotension; increased fall risk
caution_foods.action: Limit alcohol consumption; counsel on dizziness/syncope symptoms

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May exacerbate fluid retention in susceptible patients
caution_foods.action: Monitor for edema; maintain moderate sodium intake

monitoring_notes: Monitor renal function, as pramipexole is primarily renally eliminated; dose adjustments required in renal impairment. Assess for impulse control disorders, orthostatic hypotension, and somnolence, especially when initiating or combining with other CNS-active agents.
